main_finding: METH components need exactly the unchanged self-contained R4 file. KERN representation receipt verification additionally reuses the unchanged kernel component auditor as a library, without its local main. Neither library-import path requires Windows power/ownership modules, whole-agent search/HPO or a new model runtime.

python_dependency_closure.requirements_pins: numpy1.26.4 and pandas2.2.3 from original allowed requirements. Actual Linux versions should be recorded, not inferred from pinned text.

integration.module_loading: Prehash each exact approved Python source, then importlib.util.spec_from_file_location + module_from_spec + spec.loader.exec_module under explicit private module names. Do not run as __main__ and do not use runpy with run_name=__main__. No import performed by this review.
integration.R4_globals: TaskVerifier/diagnostics/matched_control_comparison and their function closure reference no WORK/ROOT/REPO globals (AST checked). Explicit directory/spec/frames/partition arguments suffice. Do not call expected_partition/work_path unless separately configured.

integration.why_no_HPO8: HPO/planner/initial assessment/final-refit requirements live in r4.verify_task/main, not TaskVerifier/diagnostics. Component verification uses full=False and qualifies only the saved component output.
integration.why_kernel_main_is_not_portable_unchange: It binds local kern01/kern00/m4/t7 directory tree, historical Windows NPZ byte SHA map, local Stage0 registry483/694 inventories, supervisor/closure/clock receipt schemas and fixed campaign clocks. Those are wrapper authority for the original run, not transitive dependencies of representation_receipt.

local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.before_truth: The Linux harness must hash its exact source/job/spec/input/split inventories and every terminal component core+supervisor/seal BEFORE loading label-bearing CSVs or calling R4, then recheck them after scoring. R4 is the numerical/artifact verifier, not a process supervisor or seal authority.
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.task_files_not_published: The5 pristine task files remain local on Linux; predeclared input hashes bind them. No data/NPZ/predictions/native weights need enter Git.
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.spec_contract: Native paths and n_train/n_test/features/categorical_features/target/id/classes/output_columns/prediction_type=value/sample_test_positions/time_column remain frozen. R4 verifies target/ID exclusion, no missing target, class order sorted from train, sample/test row mapping.
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.job_contract: Fresh top-level job.json with native absolute output_dir/split_path, exact spec/recipe, threads2, full_fit=false. Do not rewrite a closed result/job string merely to hide a stale Windows path. Generate/rebind the native dispatch before execution.
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.path_pitfall: On POSIX, Path(Windows_backslash_path).name does not extract the intended basename. Use explicit authorized role/relative file maps or native discover output rather than basename heuristics on old Windows spec paths.
successful_classification_additionally_r: complete recursive component-i artifacts for strong feature-view or ensemble recipes
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.class_probability_order: R4 aligns stored NPZ classes to canonical spec.classes, checks finite [0,1] rows summing1 and sample-position/ID/argmax equality. Test NPZ need not have row_position.
local_native_inputs_and_artifacts.failure: Existing worker failure/timeout remains metric=null. Do not call diagnostics on failure or fabricate zero; incomplete required cuts remain incomplete.

native_split_binding.root_reported_resolved: Root says exact five Linux-native NPZ derived hashes are bound by receipt211e51fa; this review does not read/recompute those arrays.
native_split_binding.binding_rule: Keep original five row partitions/order fixed. Use the actual approved native five NPZ hashes from the derived manifest for job/split seals and diagnostics.split_file_sha256; retain old Windows NPZ hashes as historical provenance only.
native_split_binding.do_not_reuse_unchanged_kernel_main_CUT_S: Its old serializer-byte hash constants reject a different valid native NPZ container. representation_receipt itself does not consult CUT_SHA; it accepts the caller-provided prevalidated native split.
native_split_binding.array_identity: Bind dtype/shape/order and ordered train+validation positions fingerprint separately from NPZ ZIP-container bytes. No reseeding/new cuts/reordering permitted.

checks_provided_by_reused_core: Manual original-scale RMSE or manual MacroF1 from pristine local labels, stored CSV truth/prediction consistency; no model fitting or sklearn metric dependency.
Native integer split bounds/uniqueness/disjointness; exact validation row order and finite predictions; full CSV/sample schema/ID order.
Recursive ensemble/feature-view probability or regression mixtures and child expected recipes/iteration tree for fresh job materializations.
Class fitting raw-feature-hash groups disjoint from validation, per-class independent feature-group counts and rarest-class exclusion. These are feature groups, not independent entities.
Regression forward time chronology; class matched primary42/confirmation43 MacroF1/support/ex-rarest gates.
KERN receipt fitting-order/schema/profile/seed42/threads2/head/gamma128 dimensions/per-matrix128M cap and representation byte metadata; it does not refit a preprocessor.
limits: This minimal closure does not validate remote wall/RSS/ownership or certify a whole-agent pipeline, refit, default release, private score or promotion. The existing Linux outer harness owns these.

TaskVerifier does not itself prove full teacher/preprocessor fit-only native state; unchanged source plus applicable recorded fitting-scope/representation receipts and wrapper lineage remain necessary.

representation_receipt validates the fitting_state_sha256 format and reported identity, not an independently reconstructed learned transformer. No speedup/quality claim follows from source portability.
R4 uses asserts: actual audit must run nonoptimized Python (no -O), and the harness should require __debug__ before invoking it.
